# Vendored tree-sitter Rust parser

`src/parser.c.gz` and `src/tree_sitter/parser.h` are generated grammar assets
from [`tree-sitter/tree-sitter-rust`](https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-rust)
tag `v0.24.2` (revision `77a3747266f4d621d0757825e6b11edcbf991ca5`, the
source of the `tree-sitter-rust` 0.24.2 crate) with `meta-language.patch`
applied, regenerated by tree-sitter CLI 0.25.10. `src/scanner.c` and
`src/tree_sitter/alloc.h` are the unmodified upstream files of that revision.

The patch adds syntax that real published crates use and the release reports
as errors (each case is in `test/corpus/meta_language.txt`):

- `~` and bare `$` inside macro token trees (`anyhow`, `serde_json`, `syn`);
- unit structs with a where clause, `struct S where T: Bound;` (`syn`);
- attributes on struct-pattern fields and on later tuple elements
  (`proc-macro2`, `zerovec`);
- `e as T <= f`, where `<=` cannot open type arguments (`unsafe-libyaml`);
- the unit type on the left of a where predicate (`typenum`);
- turbofish calls of functions named like primitive types, `f32::<_>(x)` (`nom`);
- the Rust 2015 `try!` macro (`autocfg`);
- cargo script frontmatter (`aws-lc-rs`).

With it all 7,093 `.rs` files below 400 KiB in the 302 published crate
sources that building this repository downloads into the cargo registry parse
without error nodes, and upstream's test corpus and the new cases pass.
`node js/scripts/build-vendored-grammars.mjs --only rust` reapplies the patch
and requires the regenerated parser to equal `src/parser.c.gz`.

The uncompressed `parser.c` SHA-256 is
`c2625aed5481577ae5499995e80c1700921119e75c9ec8fc351ca02f3d9f46fa`.
The `parser.h` SHA-256 is
`180b893c8734778fd32f372dfbc27bd6ad1cd2221f26150b31256ff6716320d2`.
The `scanner.c` SHA-256 is
`9609a2f92dbb7c32bc056fd8fb94e5478428f04496696aa08b048a9b66caf283`.

The grammar is MIT licensed; see `LICENSE`. `build.rs` expands the
deterministically compressed parser into Cargo's output directory before
compilation.
